spoken_script: OpenAI claims formal proof for Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem. OpenAI has published a 160-page formal proof using an internal AI system that claims to demonstrate a finite-time blowup in the 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes equations. Why it matters: If verified, this would represent a historic breakthrough in fluid dynamics and a significant validation of AI's capability to solve complex, long-standing mathematical problems.
